name: Stack
purpose: One-dimensional layout primitive for spacing and alignment.
scenarios: Stack form fields vertically with consistent spacing
Align children to the end of a container

direction.description: Main axis of the flex container.

gap.description: Spacing step applied to the gap.

variants.name: direction
variants.description: Main axis of the flex container.

antiPatterns: Do not use physical margins; use the gap prop.
Do not nest deeply to avoid flexbox performance issues.

a11y.focus: Stack is not focusable; it only affects layout.

responsive.strategy: Direction can switch at breakpoints via the direction prop; spacing is token-based.

breakpoints.compact: Stacks stay within the viewport width; gap is preserved.
breakpoints.medium: Direction may switch to row if space allows.
breakpoints.large: Direction may switch to row if space allows.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir; row follows the flow.
